get.description: Retrieves your top-performing posts ranked by views within a specified date range

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Defines the metrics-delta window (period over which view/like/comment/share gains are summed for ranking).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Defines the metrics-delta window (period over which view/like/comment/share gains are summed for ranking).

parameters.name: posted_at_start_date
parameters.description: Start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Restricts the ranked post set to posts created on or after this date (based on posted_at). Must be supplied together with posted_at_end_date.

parameters.name: posted_at_end_date
parameters.description: End date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Restricts the ranked post set to posts created on or before this date (based on posted_at). Must be supplied together with posted_at_start_date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of results. Default is 4. Recommended is 20. Set to 10,000 to get all data.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 40. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: include_gmv
parameters.description: Include GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) data for each post. Default is false.

200.description: Top posts by views retrieved successfully

external_id.description: External platform identifier for the post

gmv.description: Gross Merchandise Value for the post (only included when include_gmv=true)
